windowsCrossCheck.scope: Actual error, batch, trash/index, adapter/policy and included test sources. Explicit shims for unrelated Tauri runtime/file helpers. This is compilation, not test execution or a full Windows application build.

contracts: exact file and nonempty directory restore
file and directory collision introduced after MoveItem queue, sentinel preservation and alternate bytes
MTA caller isolated from STA worker and public trash/restore entry points
alternate-case and verbatim DOS requests, semantic duplicate rejection, Unicode/device namespace comparison

startupBundle.claim: No frontend feature source changed and no startup latency improvement is claimed.

limits: Four permits bound live Shell threads, not every queued IPC request. Native forwards are capped at128; SCM pending work requires its own admission policy.
The native owner retains queued work; the primitive by itself only detaches after thread spawn. Hung Shell calls are not forcibly cancelled and can block inverse progress.
Windows deletion still uses the dependency operation/abort result; source-verified item completion is implemented for restore.
Equal-timestamp trash versions, symlink/canonical aliases, broader Windows ancestor aliases and artifact identity remain unresolved.
Durable journals, process/renderer crash recovery, Linux restore-parent effects, progress/cancellation and remaining transfer/grouped-rename ownership remain required.
Linux native screenshots and tests do not establish Windows/macOS behavior or Mac half-bounce readiness.
SCM filesystem behavior is covered by Rust tests; this native desktop run does not directly exercise its command route.

independentReview.sourceVerdict: CONFIRMED within stated scope and qualifications
